# ggseg

[Visualize brain atlas data in R]{.tagline}

[Get Started](packages.qmd){.btn-gradient}
:::

## Quick Install

```r
# Install from R-universe
install.packages(
 c("ggseg", "ggseg3d", "ggsegExtra"),
 repos = c(
   "https://ggseg.r-universe.dev",
   "https://cloud.r-project.org"
  )
)
```

## Core Packages {.section-header}

The ggseg suite provides tools for visualizing brain atlas data in R, built on top of ggplot2 and plotly.

::: {.package-grid}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(core_packages))) {
  pkg <- core_packages[i, ]
  cat(sprintf(
    '
::: {.package-card}
### %s
[v%s]{.version}

[%s]{.description}

::: {.links}
[Documentation](%s){target="_blank"}
[GitHub](%s){target="_blank"}
:::
:::
',
    pkg$package,
    pkg$version,
    pkg$title,
    pkg$pkgdown_url,
    pkg$github_url
  ))
}
```

:::

## Atlas Packages

The ggseg ecosystem includes `r nrow(get_atlas_packages())` atlas packages providing data for different brain parcellations.
